ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the camp's fire

plain.li: Dreamt the camp's people and ours were mending the same net, one at each end, and met in the middle.
In the dream the camp's people taught me their song, and I knew all the words by the end.
The camp and the colony were one place in my dream, with no wall between.
[child] The camp children and me built a fort in my dream, and nobody had to go home.

warm.li: Dreamt one of their old women braided my hair by the fire and told me who I looked like.

blunt.li: Sat at the camp's fire in my sleep. Good people.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the camp threw a dance and I was very good at it. Not true. Nice dream.

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the camp's fire. They'll be gone soon.

cold.li: A dream about the camp. My mind seems to have filed them as friends.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of going with them

plain.li: In the dream I packed my things in the night and walked off with the camp, and nobody here noticed until noon.
Dreamt I was on the road with the camp's people, and every bend showed a country I'd never seen.
The camp folded up its tents with me inside one, and I let it.

blunt.li: Dreamt I left with the camp. Didn't. Thought about it.

cheerful.li: Dreamt I joined the camp and learned to juggle and cook on a stick. Then I came back for supper.

gloomy.li: I went with them, and the colony forgot me before I reached the hill.

cold.li: A dream about leaving. The road has its appeal. So does the roof.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the fever at the door

plain.li: In the dream the sickness walked up the road like a traveler and knocked, and I couldn't remember if I'd barred the door.
Dreamt every bed in the colony had someone in it, and I couldn't tell which of them were ours.
The children were coughing in my dream, all of them, and I went from bed to bed with one cup of water.

warm.li: Dreamt I nursed half the region through the fever, and woke up so tired it felt real.

blunt.li: Dreamt the fever got in. Counted heads at breakfast. All here.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the fever reached us, and we'd been expecting it so long we just set out more beds.

cold.li: A dream about the epidemic reaching the colony. A reasonable thing to be afraid of.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the dry fields

plain.li: In the dream our own fields went the way of theirs, yellow and then gray, while I watched from the gate.
Dreamt I dug for potatoes and found only stones, row after row.
Hungry people stood at the wall in silence, and I knew every one of their faces.

warm.li: Dreamt we shared what we had with the hungry on the road, and it stretched, like bread in a story, to all of them.

blunt.li: Crops failed in my dream. They haven't. I looked.

gloomy.li: Dreamt the hunger in the region came here. Hard to say it won't.

cold.li: A dream about our stores running out. I'll count them again today.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the busy road

plain.li: Dreamt the road was full of carts going both ways, and every one of them stopped to wave.
In the dream the whole region came to a fair at our gate, and nobody had brought a weapon.
A town I've never been to, and they knew the colony's name there, and said it kindly.
[child] I dreamt there was a fair with a ribbon for every child, and I got two.

warm.li: Dreamt of good times for everyone, near and far, and I didn't have to choose who.

cheerful.li: Dreamt the good news kept coming, one rider after another, until we ran out of places to sit them!

gloomy.li: Dreamt things were getting better out there. Hard to trust a dream like that. I liked it, though.

cold.li: A hopeful dream. The region's prospects do seem improved.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the good turn

plain.li: Dreamt I went to thank them properly, and the road to their fire was lined with lanterns.
In the dream I paid back the kindness, and then they paid it back again, and it went on all night.
The strangers who helped us were in my dream, and there they weren't strangers at all.

warm.li: Dreamt everyone who has ever helped me stood in one room, and I had time to thank each of them.

blunt.li: We owe them. Even my sleep knows it.

gloomy.li: Dreamt I never got to thank them. I'd better, while I can.

cold.li: A dream about the debt of gratitude. It should be settled.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the shut gate

plain.li: In the dream they were still out there past the gate, in the rain, and I was the one holding the bar.
Dreamt I went out to say sorry, and the road was empty all the way to the hills.
Their children looked back at the colony as they left, and in the dream I couldn't look away.

warm.li: Dreamt I ran after them with food and blankets, and I got there just in time. I wish I had.

blunt.li: Sent them off again, in my sleep. Not proud of it.

gloomy.li: We drove them off again, and again, every night the same.

cold.li: A dream about the decision. My conscience disagrees with the council.
